overclaims: A stricter reading, or a loss measure taken before minority-interest allocation, would put the loss outside the range.
The post-conversion loss figures come from shareholder documents reported by The Information, and Reuters could not verify them.
This fails the 'six or so months' timetable.
checks.note: The proposition omits the promised conversion timetable. The payload otherwise shows the conditions and matches the agreed outcome. No cited evidence establishes the pre-allocation loss. Reuters' verification caveat concerns cash burn, not the cited operating loss. May's pending conversion alone cannot establish failure against the contract's June 30 deadline; October completion does.
